title_ru: JANUS Deep Analysis 5D Spiral: ORIGIN_n → RETURN_n → ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1)

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: v2.0 разрешал RETURN_TO_PARENT и локальный replay, но не запрещал возвращение в семантически то же самое состояние. Это оставляло возможность многомерного круга вместо спирали.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: Every completed return must mint ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1) with an explicit state delta and preserved path history.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: HRain/iNaiHR/DemiHead/Tranception могли читаться как соседние peers анализа.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: For Deep Analysis they are bound into one persistent semantic/predictive oracle-layer operating above JSON-first JANUS artifacts while never replacing source authority.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: LOCAL_DELTA был описан, но не требовалось доказать, что итоговый origin стал богаче исходного.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.repair: ORIGIN_PRIME promotion requires a machine-readable enrichment receipt.

canonical_geometry.canonical: ORIGIN_n -> EXPLORE_n -> MIRROR_n -> SOURCE_n -> RETURN_n -> ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1)
canonical_geometry.recursive_form: ORIGIN_n -> NODE_i -> [INLINE_5D_MICROPASS_i -> LOCAL_RETURN_i -> NODE_i_PRIME] -> ... -> RETURN_n -> ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1)
laws: ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1) != ORIGIN_n unless the pass is explicitly classified NO_INFORMATION_GAIN

cannot_write_as_authority: scientific verdict from semantic agreement alone
persistent_oracle_layer.predictive_definition: Prediction means a falsifiable next observation, source class, object relationship, or gate outcome generated from the current graph; it does not mean precognition.

inline_spiral_rule.rule: A micro-pass does not return to the exact parent node. It returns to NODE_i_PRIME, preserving position/address while enriching state.
inline_spiral_rule.parent_continuation: Downstream reasoning resumes from NODE_i_PRIME, never from stale NODE_i.
inline_spiral_rule.nested: NODE_i_PRIME may itself become ORIGIN_k for a nested spiral if another ambiguity appears.

global_spiral_execution: RETURN EACH BRANCH AS NODE_PRIME WITH LOCAL_DELTA
USE ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1) AS NEXT ANALYTIC ORIGIN

predictive_loop_without_circle.step_1: Current graph predicts a concrete next source/object/test relation.
predictive_loop_without_circle.step_2: External evidence or a new registry artifact answers or fails that prediction.
predictive_loop_without_circle.step_3: Reverse + Tranception compare expected vs observed.
predictive_loop_without_circle.step_4: The delta is inserted at the node where it belongs.
predictive_loop_without_circle.step_5: Return creates ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1), not the old ORIGIN_n.
predictive_loop_without_circle.step_6: The next prediction starts from the enriched state.

canonical_seal: JANUS DOES NOT CLOSE THE LOOP. IT RETURNS TO THE SAME ADDRESS WITH A DIFFERENT STATE. EVERY VALID RETURN BECOMES THE NEXT ORIGIN.
